burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Creates a DoT which deals 20 Base Power (of the Source) DMG for 5 turns.

hawk_eye.name: Hawk's Eye
hawk_eye.description: Increases user's Reaction DMG Bonus by +20%.

pristine_health.name: Pristine Health
pristine_health.description: Provides +30% Incoming Healing. Upon falling below 33% HP, dying, or status expiration, triggers an immediate burst heal equal to 40% of Reyna's max HP.

oathbearer.name: Oathbearer
oathbearer.description: At the end of every turn, deals 25 Base Power Water DMG to all enemies and heals all allies by 25% of Reyna's Max HP.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Increases owner's Magic stat by 25% of Sailor's Magic and triggers follow-up 'Super Sonic Slash' when target's Weakness is reduced.

dominique_marker.name: Marker
dominique_marker.description: Tracks marker stacks from Dominique's attacks. Increases reaction damage on the target.

ace_mode.name: Ace Mode
ace_mode.description: Replaces standard basic attack with Remarkable Shot! and increases Toughness Damage dealing potential by 1.5x.

smothered.name: Smothered
smothered.description: Decreases user's ATK by 50% for one turn.

electrocuted.name: Electrocuted
electrocuted.description: Amplifies the inflicting skill’s DMG by 1.3x, then creates a DoT which deals 10 Base Power for 3 turns.

damp.name: Damp
damp.description: Decreases user's DEF by 33% for one turn.

muddied.name: Muddied
muddied.description: Decreases user's SPE by 33% for one turn.

isolate.name: Isolate
isolate.description: Stunned and unable to take action.
